#ME The Iranian agency Tasnim reported on Friday evening a missile strike on the island of Qeshm in the Strait of Hormuz. According to an agency affiliated with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, the missile fell on the outskirts of the city of Qeshm at 18:50 local time . Tasnim blamed the US and Israel for the attack, without providing evidence. There is no information yet about damage or casualties. About 20 minutes earlier, an unknown shell hit an oil tanker leaving the Strait of Hormuz. According to the British maritime security service UKMTO, the incident occurred about 15 kilometers north of the Omani port of Hasab. A fire broke out on board. No reports of casualties or sea pollution were received. The ship's ownership and the origin of the shell have not yet been established. No one has yet claimed responsibility for the tanker's damage. 🏛️ Members of Congress from the Popular Renewal, Good Governance, Together for Peru, and Obras parties introduced a motion dated November 19 calling on Foreign Minister Hugo de Zela to appear before Congress and account for the organization, logistics, and shortcomings that occurred during the Pope’s visit. 💰 The initiative demands full transparency regarding the use of public funds, including details on contracts, funding sources, amounts allocated per entity, and the functions carried out by the Extraordinary High-Level Commission. 🎙️ In addition, lawmakers are demanding clarification regarding the audio and video malfunctions that occurred during the farewell Mass on November 16 at Las Palmas Air Base, calling for a review of technical oversight and the determination of responsibilities.
